wait: portable platform timer, no tuned spin, original10ms targets and budgets unchanged
fault: Crash injected by separate process outside monitor; actual death timestamp logged
isolation: Linux parent highest allowed CPU, helpers next CPU and nice19 where supported; no host isolation or hard realtime claim
heartbeat: Independent preallocated native monotonic absolute-sleep heartbeat,3x5s nominal and3x5s worker-core stress, no controller. Baseline context only, not equivalent full-system load.
criterion: Any miss fails observed strict10ms; output commit timestamps after fallback handling. Functional checks and timing separate; no rebase, dropped ticks or forgiven misses. Run after development, not during training/evaluation.
kernel_benchmark: 2000states x3seed blocks, randomized reference/scalar order per identical input, warmed exact equations; timing only the kernel call
